name: geoattend
description: GeoAttend — GPS-based employee attendance, geofencing and shift-scoped workforce tracking.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @geoattend/api" "npm run dev -w @geoattend/admin" "npm run dev -w @geoattend/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @geoattend/admin && npm run build -w @geoattend/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,admin,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w @geoattend/api" "npm run start -w @geoattend/admin" "npm run start -w @geoattend/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @geoattend/shared && npm run test -w @geoattend/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @geoattend/shared && npm run typecheck -w @geoattend/api && npm run typecheck -w @geoattend/admin && npm run typecheck -w @geoattend/web
